text:
lucy: quick accessibility note from the console review: roving focus in the deploy cards is inconsistent. sometimes Tab lands on the card body not the card action, then arrow keys don't work.
omar: can repro. looks like we have tabindex=0 on several nested elements inside the card which breaks the single-tab-stop pattern.
tara: that explains VoiceOver behavior where rotor shows too many stops and the selected state isn't announced.
aria-bot: a11y-scan (deploy-cards): issues found: 3 (roving tabindex, low contrast on secondary action, missing aria-label on close button)
lucy: proposals:
- enforce single tabindex=0 per card (container) and make inner interactive elements tabindex=-1 until card is focused; manage focus with ArrowLeft/Right for navigation and Enter/Space to activate primary action.
- bump secondary action text color to #0A3D7A on light bg or add 2px strong underline to help contrast.
- add aria-label="close card" on the small X button and aria-hidden on decorative icons.
omar: sample JS snippet I sketched:
```
cards.forEach((c, i) => {
  c.setAttribute('tabindex', i===active? '0' : '-1')
  c.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') focusCard(i+1)
    if (e.key === 'Enter') activatePrimary(c)
  })
})
```
tara: tests to add:
- keyboard nav: Tab enters card, arrows move between cards, Enter activates primary, Space toggles details
- screen reader: NVDA/VoiceOver announce "Card title, selected" when focused
lucy: acceptance criteria added to INS-6780: roving tabindex implemented, focus visible at 2x zoom, closed X has aria-label, secondary action contrast >= 4.5:1 for normal text.
aria-bot: created INS-6780 and queued a11y-e2e. ETA 4d.
omar: I'll push a small CSS + JS patch and include visual diff. will ping when ready for review.
lucy: cheers. please include screenshots of VoiceOver rotor and NVDA focus mode. closing thread for now. :sparkles:
